name: Plasma One
summary: Plasma One is a self-custodial stablecoin Visa card built on the Plasma blockchain. You top up with USDT or USDC, spend anywhere Visa is accepted across 180+ countries, keep earning up to ~6% yield on your balance, and collect up to 4% cashback paid in XPL, with zero fees on Plasma-routed transfers. Access is invite-only via a free code.

fees.topup: Free on Plasma routes (third-party fees may apply)

rewards.welcomeBonus: Core tier free for the first year during launch promotions

availabilityNotes: Plasma One is available in 180+ countries where Visa is accepted, subject to geographic and regulatory limits. Account services are provided by Bridge and the card is issued by Rain, a Visa Principal Member. Availability is invite-only during the current phase. Confirm eligibility in the app.

kyc.notes: Plasma One is invite-only: you need a free access code, then complete KYC with an email, phone number and government ID. Proof of address is not usually requested. Never pay for an access code. Official codes are always free.

pros: Zero fees on Plasma-routed stablecoin transfers
Up to 4% cashback paid in XPL, tier dependent
Keep earning up to ~6% variable yield on your balance
Fully self-custodial: Plasma never holds your assets
Spend in 180+ countries with Apple Pay and Google Pay
cons: Invite-only: you need a free access code to join
Yield comes from third-party DeFi vaults and can lose value
Best cashback and yield require the paid or XPL-locked tiers
Cashback is paid in volatile XPL rather than a stablecoin
Newer platform with a short operating track record
howToGet: Download the Plasma One app (iOS or Android).
Enter a free access code: ours is pre-filled when you use our link. Codes are invite-only.
Complete KYC with your email, phone number and a government ID.
Top up with USDT or USDC on the Plasma network (or from an exchange such as Cryptal).
Add the virtual card to Apple Pay or Google Pay and start spending.

faq.question: What is Plasma One?
faq.answer: Plasma One is a self-custodial stablecoin account with a Visa card built on the Plasma blockchain. You top up with USDT or USDC, spend anywhere Visa is accepted, and earn cashback and yield on your balance.

faq.question: Is Plasma One free?
faq.answer: There are no fees on Plasma-routed stablecoin transfers, and the Lite tier is free. The Core tier normally costs about US$120 per year but has been offered free for the first year with an access code, and the Platinum tier requires locking 100,000 XPL for 12 months.

faq.question: How do I get a Plasma One access code?
faq.answer: Plasma One is invite-only. Official access codes are free, so you can use ours, or find fresh ones in the official community. Never pay anyone for a code, as paid codes are a common scam.

faq.question: What cashback and yield does Plasma One pay?
faq.answer: Cashback ranges from 2% on Lite up to 4% base on Platinum (plus boosted rates on AI spending and flights), paid in XPL. Idle balances can earn up to about 6% variable yield through third-party DeFi vaults, which carry risk and are not guaranteed.

faq.question: Is my money safe with Plasma One?
faq.answer: Plasma One is self-custodial: Plasma does not hold your assets. However, the yield feature routes funds into third-party DeFi vaults that are not deposit-insured and can lose value. Stablecoin balances are not bank deposits.
